question: Consider the sets defined by the inequalities \(A=\{(x,y)\in\mathbb R^2:x^4+y^2\le1\},\ B=\{(x,y)\in\mathbb R^2:x^6+y^4\le1\}.\) Then

options.C: each of the sets \(A-B, B-A\) and \(A\cap B\) is non-empty
options.D: none of the above is true.
